summary: Order updates by polling 5paisa's order book (web PollingOrderUpdateAdapter, desktop common::order_poll::OrderPoller): the first read (an empty book) is a silent baseline, then an order open, 40 of 100 filled, complete, a manual MARKET order first seen in the book (its row priced) and filled, a rejection with 5paisa's full RMS text, and an SL order open then cancelled.

notes: web.json is computed through scripts/feed_corpus/web_adapters/polling.py: the web's own PollingOrderUpdateAdapter._poll_loop and _publish_order, services/orderbook_service.py get_orderbook and format_order_data, and 5paisa's map_order_data, calculate_order_statistics and transform_order_data, each served book as the poller's next read.

OrderBook rows follow 5paisa's V3 OrderBook fields (BrokerOrderId, OrderStatus, Qty, TradedQty, PendingQty, Rate, AveragePrice, SLTriggerRate, AtMarket, DelvIntra, Reason). The Reason on the cancelled order is illustrative.

deviations.reason: The web's 5paisa book (transform_order_data) has no filled_quantity, so the poller's (order_status, filled_quantity) never changes on a partial fill and the web publishes nothing for it; the desktop reads TradedQty and publishes the fill.
The web sends 0 for every 5paisa order (its book has no filled_quantity), a completed one included; the desktop sends TradedQty.
The web sends 0 for every 5paisa order (its book has no pending_quantity); the desktop sends PendingQty.
The web sends 0.0 for every 5paisa order (its book has no average_price); the desktop sends AveragePrice.

The web's 5paisa book carries 5paisa's Reason as reason, and the poller reads rejection_reason, so a rejected order goes out with an empty reason; the desktop sends 5paisa's RMS text. Lost data on the web.
